basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old gamer living in Indianapolis, Indiana. I work as a graphic designer during the day and spend my evenings exploring the depths of video game dungeons. I have a particular love for challenging games like Bloodborne, which explains my frequent visits to the 'huntersbell' subreddit. When I'm not slaying virtual beasts, I'm usually binge-watching animated series like 'Love, Death & Robots' or enjoying classic wrestling commentary from Jim Cornette. I'm currently single and enjoy the freedom it gives me to dedicate time to my hobbies. My typical online hours are between 7 PM and midnight, which is when I find time to unwind and engage with the Reddit community.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a self-taught graphic designer, I've developed an eye for aesthetics and creativity. My knowledge of gaming comes from years of playing various genres, from RPGs to action-adventure games. I spend a lot of time reading game guides and watching playthroughs to improve my skills.
